type G<T> = any[T];
type H<T extends null> = any[T];
type K<T> = any[T | null];
const a: G<{}> = 1;
const b: H<null> = 2;
const c: K<{}> = 3;
const d: any[never] = 's';
const e: any[keyof any] = true;
const f: any[`before-${number}`] = {};
const sym = Symbol();
const g: any[typeof sym] = 1;
console.log(a, b, c, d, e, f, g);
function property<K>(object: any, key: K) { return object[key]; }
const dictionary: any = { key: 'old' };
dictionary['key'] = 'new';
const symbol = Symbol('label');
dictionary[symbol] = 'symbol';
console.log(property(dictionary, 'key'), dictionary?.[symbol]);
